items.summary: The group exfiltrated 4,207 employee national-ID records linked to health and psychotropic-drug dispensing data plus 82 GB of pharmaceutical IP including drug formulations and API synthesis methods. Hudson Rock traced the intrusion to the Cavalier infostealer family.
items.title: Aurora ransomware hits Laboratorios Roemmers, Argentina's largest pharma company

items.summary: The city formally notified residents on September 29 after the RansomHouse leak-site listing on August 6; its notice cites names, Social Security numbers and driver's license numbers. A local researcher found tax returns, bank records, HR files and police records in the leaked data, and disputed the ~76-day notification gap.
items.title: McMinnville, Oregon formally notifies residents of RansomHouse ransomware breach

items.summary: CVE-2026-94127 is a heap-based buffer overflow in BIG-IP Access Policy Manager that lets unauthenticated attackers execute arbitrary commands; F5 confirmed active exploitation and watchTowr published technical details with a working proof-of-concept.
items.title: F5 BIG-IP Access Policy Manager zero-day (CVE-2026-94127, CVSS 9.8) exploited in the wild

items.summary: The Australian Signals Directorate's ACSC updated its critical alert after Australian organizations confirmed exploitation of CVE-2026-88771 (remote code execution, CVSS 9.5) and CVE-2026-88778; both are CISA KEV-listed and Citrix published indicators of compromise.
items.title: Australian agencies confirm active exploitation of Citrix NetScaler flaws

items.summary: CVE-2026-84782 lets a DTLS peer leak heap memory or crash the process; OpenSSL released patches on September 29 urging immediate updates for DTLS-dependent apps like WebRTC and VoIP. CISA rates it CVSS 8.2 with no reported exploitation yet.
items.title: OpenSSL patches high-severity DTLS heap-memory leak (CVE-2026-84782)

items.summary: Proofpoint's TA419 campaign impersonated an Anthropic employee and former officials like Lynne Parker in AI-collaboration emails that steered targets to password-stealing sites. No successful breaches were found, but the targeting aligns with Chinese intelligence-collection priorities.
items.title: China-linked TA419 impersonated AI officials to target AI experts, Proofpoint says
